notes: Clean role-S claim on a fully public shared-task benchmark with a full system prompt (Appendix A, Listing 1) and a gold AVeriTeC-scoring script, scored via an external EvalAI blackbox. Only gap: this paper never restates the exact dev/test item counts in text (the standard AVeriTeC split is documented in Schlichtkrull et al. 2024, not repeated here), so n_items is not directly citable from this paper's own text -- the one soft gap keeping this at "maybe" rather than "eligible". The authors' own logged cost ($0.04-0.08 per fact-check, ~9000 calls / $363 during development) confirms a high cost tier.
